summary: Learn e-procurement systems implementation and change management with workflows, ADKAR, and dashboards. Build rollout tools you can use immediately.
lede: Change management in e-procurement helps procurement professionals plan and stabilize digital purchasing workflows. For teams implementing or stabilizing these systems, the course covers readiness and stakeholder assessment, approval workflow design with procurement controls, and adoption measurement through dashboards and reporting. Exercises also address system selection, integration dependencies, go-live planning, and sustainment.
audienceIntro: This course is built for people who already work with procurement operations and now need to implement or stabilize an e-procurement system. It speaks to the daily decisions you make around approvals, supplier data, user adoption, controls, and reporting.
modules: E-Procurement Operating Model and Change Case
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop and be prepared to work with sample procurement workflows, approval rules, and reporting templates. No programming is required, but you should have access to basic procurement process knowledge and a willingness to review current-state documents, supplier records, and KPI examples.
